findings.evidence: Lines 81–83 prove the diagonal value, while `isIdempotentElem_carOccupationProjection` at lines 121–122 requires `i ≠ j`; Mathlib's projection terminology denotes idempotent operators/elements, as witnessed by `Submodule.isIdempotentElem_projection` in `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Projection.lean:236`.
findings.fix: Rename the family and its theorems to `carOccupationElement` (or standard occupation-number terminology), or restrict the definition to off-diagonal pairs so every value genuinely is a projection.
findings.issue: `carOccupationProjection` overstates the definition: it accepts `i = j`, where `carOccupationProjection_self` shows the value is `1/2 • 1`, which is not idempotent; the same misleading root appears in all associated theorem names.

summary: The public API calls every indexed element a projection even though diagonal elements are not projections when 2 is invertible.
